name: Horizon #9
description:
Horizons

Never have I shifted my focus so much in such a short time. Web3 and NFTs have opened my mind to so many creative possibilities I’ve never experienced before. Some days I only feel excitement, and other days I feel uncertainty as we all embark on this new adventure — but I am all in. Horizons was inspired by Async’s #AsyncNewDawn contest. There are two musical compositions, both hopeful in the end, each reflecting one of those conflicting feelings. The colors and overlays in the original art are also tied to the moods. Both musical pieces make perfect soundscapes for photo collages, YouTube or Instagram videos, etc. As with all creations by me or my family, being a holder grants you early access to future drops and future token-gated experiences.
